responsibility: Declares the GCC command-line options specific to the TILE-Gx target and the generated option variables they feed. It defines -mcpu, -m32/-m64, endianness switches, and -mcmodel along with the associated enums and header inclusion, making these target flags available to generated option parsing code and to backend logic such as tilegx_option_override.
same_name_distinction: Defines the TILE-Gx-specific command-line option set and generated option variables/enums, distinct from tilegx.c which interprets and acts on those options in backend code, tilegx.h which establishes static target macros, and tilegx.md which maps operations to RTL instruction patterns.
